name: Salt-Mender
resourceDesc: Salt, a pouch of a hundred, pays for every working; it comes back slowly in a fight and quickly out of one, from the earth itself, and a ward that is struck grounds the blow into it.
identity: The salt-magic of the West: bind the Chaos, seal the Wound, sing a wall into place. Not a healer: salt holds, wards and burns the Wasting's things.

branches.name: Salt-Speaker
branches.loop: Bind the one you don't want in white crystal, seal the caster's mouth, and calcify what breaks loose; what your salt holds, the party hits harder.
branches.tradeoff: Every hold is Salt not thrown as shards, and a bound foe is not a dead one.

nodes.name: Long Binding
nodes.desc: Binding Salt holds 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Chant
nodes.desc: Seal the Wound comes back 2s sooner per rank.

nodes.name: Salt of the First Sea
nodes.desc: Binding Salt costs 5 less Salt per rank.

nodes.name: Calcify
nodes.desc: New action: Calcify: the target crusted into salt and stunned for 3s; the Wasting's things 2s more.

nodes.name: White Crust
nodes.desc: A foe your salt holds (bound, sealed or calcified) takes 3% more from the party per rank.

nodes.name: Deep Crystal
nodes.desc: Calcify holds half a second longer per rank.

nodes.name: I Seal the Wound
nodes.desc: Seal the Wound silences twice as long.

branches.name: Mason
branches.loop: Draw the line and stand behind your Salt-Ward: every blow it takes is grounded back into Salt; sing the wall up when the party is hard pressed.
branches.tradeoff: The Mason holds the line on wards that must be kept up; let the ward fall and there is only robe and salt between you and the blow.

nodes.name: Thick Salt
nodes.desc: Salt-Ward is 8% stronger per rank.

nodes.name: Grounding
nodes.desc: Each blow your Salt-Ward takes grounds 1 more Salt per rank.

nodes.name: Sap-and-Salt Mortar
nodes.desc: You take 2% less per rank.

nodes.name: Line Held
nodes.desc: Draw the Line holds 1s longer and draws more hate per rank.

nodes.name: Spiked Wall
nodes.desc: While your Salt-Ward holds, a foe that strikes you takes 3 and 2 more per rank.

nodes.name: Wide Wall
nodes.desc: Sung Wall reaches 2m further and turns 3% more per rank.

nodes.name: Mason of the Weave
nodes.desc: Salt-Ward also wards everyone in your party within 8m at half its worth.

branches.name: Sifter
branches.loop: Throw salt shards from range, sing the Song of Sifting over a pack, and save the deepest burn for the Wasting's things.
branches.tradeoff: The Sifter's shards are thin against the living: its strength is against the Weave-Eaters and the Hollow Men.

nodes.name: Sharp Salt
nodes.desc: Salt Shard hits 3% harder per rank.

nodes.name: The Song of Sifting
nodes.desc: The Song of Sifting lasts 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Bane of the Wasting
nodes.desc: Your salt hits the Wasting's things 8% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Light Hand
nodes.desc: Salt Shard costs 2 less Salt per rank.

nodes.name: Brine
nodes.desc: Salt Shard slows its target 10% per rank for 3s.

nodes.name: Crystal Rain
nodes.desc: The Song of Sifting falls 1m wider per rank.

nodes.name: Split Shard
nodes.desc: Salt Shard splits: a second shard at half strikes a foe within 5m of the target.
